toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Headset stand (synthetic demo) under demo-direct as of 2026-10-24. Target revenue margin 5% yields BRL 31.38 recommended price before discount; applying a 10% discount reduces charged price to BRL 28.24. Undiscounted scenario remains contribution-positive at BRL 1.5753, while the discounted scenario turns contribution negative at BRL -1.2507, so the discount does not retain the requested margin.
assumptions: Product costs and channel rule are synthetic demonstration data and are valid only for 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26.
All revenue charges in the rule use the same charged-price basis; channel rate is 10%, fixed fee is BRL 2, tax and advertising are zero in the synthetic rule.
Failure provision is included using the stored 10% failure rate and full-print retry assumption from the product fixture.
Discount is applied to the recommended price to obtain the charged price; the requested 5% revenue margin is evaluated on the discounted case by the calculator.
limitations: Full-print retry assumption is used for failure handling.
No marketplace verification or current Shopee fee data are available.
Contribution is not net profit; it excludes broader business overhead and any costs not stored in the fixture.
Discounted scenario does not preserve the requested 5% revenue margin and becomes contribution negative.
